issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר' ('beyond the River' / 'across the River'), referring to the Euphrates, but the Chinese adds '以巴衛' (Ephrath?) which is not in the Hebrew text. The Hebrew does not name the river here; it simply says 'the River' (i.e., the Euphrates). The addition of '以巴衛' is an unsupported name not present in the source.
